How We Work

A Considered
Process

I
Private Consultation

Every relationship begins with an unhurried conversation — in person, in confidence. We listen before we advise, establishing not only what you seek but why, and what kind of life the right property should make possible.

II
Curated Selection

We present two to four properties at most — each chosen with care, never volume. Many of the finest addresses in Miami never reach the open market; our access to off-market inventory is the product of relationships cultivated over a decade.

III
Private Showing

Showings are arranged on your schedule, without other parties present, allowing for the kind of thoughtful inspection that an important decision deserves. We accompany every viewing personally.

IV
Discreet Negotiation

We negotiate on your behalf with the same restraint and intelligence we would apply to our own affairs. Price, timing, terms — every element is considered with equal attention.

V
Seamless Transition

From legal coordination to trusted contractor introductions, our post-closing support ensures your arrival in the property is effortless. The relationship does not end at the closing table.

"She found us a property we never would have found ourselves — and negotiated the terms without us losing a night's sleep."
